study.question: Is first observed order size associated with another purchase within 90 days?
study.hypothesis: H0: the two groups have equal 90-day repeat-purchase rates (two-sided).
study.method: Two-sided pooled two-proportion z-test; Wilson group CIs; unpooled Wald difference CI.
study.limitations: Observational association; no causal effect. First observed order may not be acquisition. Country, season and wholesale mix may confound results. Same-timestamp invoices do not count as a subsequent purchase.
